new_processes.name: Origination report maintenance
new_processes.definition: Keeping the origination file and report of originated deals complete and accurate for the originating group.

new_processes.name: Auditor monthly testing document requests
new_processes.definition: Supplying P&L top pages, deal tickets, confirmations and forward details requested by the external auditor for its monthly testing, including delegating the request to the right team member.

new_processes.name: Staff placement request
new_processes.definition: Requesting that a person be brought into a group, with location and administrative details.

new_processes.name: Candidate recruiting and interviews
new_processes.definition: Selecting candidates, arranging interviewers and handling candidate contact with HR for open positions.

new_processes.name: Deal booking clarification
new_processes.definition: Answering back-office questions on how a deal or leg should be classified in the booking system.

new_processes.name: Deal rate change request
new_processes.definition: Requests to change the rate on a deal for a production period, confirmed as done.
